script_text: Stop scrolling — Libra and Sagittarius share air-fire sextile that ignites brilliance or burns out. Libra’s Venus-ruled Air craves harmony while Sagittarius’s Jupiter-ruled Fire demands expansion, forming a sextile. Air feeds Fire, yet Fire can scorch Libra’s need for balance if unchecked. Libra’s Venus in 1st meets Sagittarius’s Mars in 9th, a Venus-Mars square fueling push-pull romance. Libra offers compromise; Sagittarius offers freedom — attraction from ideals, repulsion from fear of confinement. Mercury in Libra (3rd) seeks diplomacy while Mercury in Sagittarius (3rd) fires arrows, a Mercury-Mercury opposition. The fix: Libra speaks plainly, Sagittarius listens before preaching. Saturn in Aries squares Venus (10th Libra) and Jupiter (5th Sagittarius), testing commitment and career. A venture honoring Libra’s aesthetics and Sagittarius’s vision turns the Saturn test into a foundation. 'Vision-check' meetings let Libra map beauty and Sagittarius inject strategy, converting the Venus-Mars square into fuel. Comment your partner’s sign!
